text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Satsuki Sho, the weather 
was... rain. For Narita Top Road, who 
struggles on poor track conditions, this 
was a massive trial.

However, other Umamusume were facing 
trials of their own— Admire Vega had lost 
her appetite, and seemed to be far from 
peak condition.

TM Opera O appears before the two of them. 
Though she seems to be playing the fool— 
is that her true nature, or...

With everyone carrying their own burdens, 
the first leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown—the Satsuki Sho begins!
